_doc: Travel & Map Formula D (design/gdd/travel-map.md; values as written there, 25 km tiles). speed: tiles a season by mode (road, wilderness, river down and up, sea; flight by realm id). Values the GDD marks as guesses are listed in guesses. biome_cost: c_p, the travel cost of a tile part by biome (lake and sea are walked around: they carry no cost and are left out of the weights; a sea tile is impassable on foot). road_terrain_share: r_share, how much terrain slows a road (road c_t = 1 + r_share x (c_wild - 1)). travel_speed_floor: f_min, the least travel_speed_pct can slow travel to. partial_season_efficiency: eta, the cultivation rate of a trip's last part-season. flight_drain_per_season: f_drain. tools/design/map/export_continent.py reads biome_cost and road_terrain_share to cost each route; ContinentData.trip_seasons turns a route's cost into seasons.
